MGR-001.1/.2: every visible semantic claim must carry Provenance/Truth_State or show Unavailable/omit.
MGR-001.3: a numeric quality value may be called confidence only when bounded [0,1] with calibration evidence; otherwise label 'Relative score' with algorithm/profile version.

MGR-011.1: connected components must be named `component` in code, contracts, tests, docs, and UI (NOT `community`).
MGR-011.3: centrality output must carry the named algorithm and evaluated scope.
MGR-012: one renderer-neutral Semantic_Scene consumed by 2D view + synchronized list/table + optional 3D, with typed renderer-independent actions.
MGR-014.3: a synchronized semantic list/table must exist for every graph-visible item and action.
MGR-015.1/.2: the authoritative 2D view must complete all workflows without optional 3D and render only a query-defined bounded scene with honest totals/truncation.
MGR-026.3/.5/.6: encode states without opacity-only; omit a visual channel when the backing value is unavailable; never reveal hidden policy classes via color/gaps/counts.

synthetic_topology.what: Nine fixed categories (Projects, Knowledge, Goals, Skills, Events, Ideas, People, Conversations, Other) each with a hardcoded x/y screen position, icon, tone/color, and keyword list. None of these come from authority data.
synthetic_topology.honesty: Rendered as hubs labeled 'Generated facet · N memories' with data-generated='true' / data-authority-class='navigation' (MGR-001.4-aligned labeling).
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-001.4 (navigation groups must be labeled generated + excluded from topology) — labeling present; but the categories themselves are a fabricated ontology, not derived facets.

synthetic_topology.site: memoryUniverseModel.ts categoryForNode() — haystack = node.label.toLowerCase(); keyword substring match
synthetic_topology.what: Each entity is assigned to one of the 9 facets by naive case-insensitive substring keyword matching on its display label (fallback 'Other'). This invents a categorization/grouping with no backing in the memory model.
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-001.4 / MGR-011.6 (generated facets = navigation, not ontology). The grouping is client-fabricated and label-driven; it can misclassify and presents an invented taxonomy.

synthetic_topology.what: Node x/y positions are computed from an FNV-1a hash of the node id plus orbit/angle math around the hardcoded facet center; node radius from sqrt(centrality). Layout/positions are fully synthetic and NOT a backend/query-defined layout.
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-015.2 (2D view must render a query-defined bounded Semantic_Scene) — current layout is a decorative client synthesis, not a scene layout with honest totals/truncation.

synthetic_topology.site: MemoryUniverse.tsx <g class='memory-universe__core'> ('CURRENT FOCUS' / 'Visible memory view' / 'N memories shown')
synthetic_topology.what: A central star/core node is always drawn. It is a synthetic UI anchor, not an authority record/entity.
synthetic_topology.honesty: Its labels describe the view ('Visible memory view', 'N memories shown') rather than asserting a fake entity, so it is honest-ish, but it is still a fabricated node in the topology.
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-001.1/MGR-026.1 (visible items should map to record kinds).

synthetic_topology.site: graphData.ts expand(): additions.push({ id, label: id.slice(0,8), community: -1, centrality: 1 })
synthetic_topology.what: When expanding a focus node, relationship endpoints not already present are injected as nodes with a FABRICATED label (first 8 chars of the id), community -1, and centrality 1 (a made-up value, not the entity's real degree).
synthetic_topology.authority_backed: partial (the ids/edges are backend-sourced, but the injected label and centrality=1 are fabricated)
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-001.1 (no invented state) / MGR-026.5 (omit a channel when its value is unavailable — here a fake centrality is invented instead of omitted).

synthetic_topology.what: Edges are drawn as decorative quadratic curves with a bend factor; the curvature is purely aesthetic and carries no semantic meaning.
synthetic_topology.requirement: MGR-026.8 (polish must not carry fake meaning) — low risk, but the curve is decorative.

inert_controls.site: MemoryUniverse.tsx toolbar <button ... onClick={() => setTimeline(v => !v)}><Icon name='clock'/> Timeline</button>
inert_controls.wiring: References undefined `timeline()`/`setTimeline` (TS2304 compile error). No timeline view is rendered anywhere in the component. Fully inert AND broken.
inert_controls.implies_capability: A temporal/timeline workflow (MGR-015.1 lists 'history' as a required 2D workflow) that is not implemented in this renderer.

inert_controls.wiring: setLens() only updates the `lens()` signal, which is written to a `data-lens` attribute on the section (CSS emphasis only). The SVG render path always draws the relationship layer, facet layer, and core regardless of lens — the buttons do NOT filter or switch what is rendered.
inert_controls.implies_capability: Distinct 'lenses' (facet vs relationship vs prediction emphasis) that appear to change the view but only toggle a CSS attribute.
inert_controls.requirement: MGR-012.3 (typed renderer-independent actions) — these are cosmetic toggles, not scene/action switches.

inert_controls.wiring: onClick sets selection to core and resets the camera. It does NOT re-run or re-arrange any layout (layout is the deterministic hash synthesis). The label 'Auto arrange' misrepresents a camera/selection reset.

graphData.togglePin toggles the `pinned` set. Per graphData's own comment the shipped 2D/table 'expose no pin action because deterministic positions do not consume them' — nothing in the active SVG layout reads `pinned`. The pin state is consumed only by the DORMANT GraphCanvas3D. So the control mutates state that no live renderer reads = inert.
inert_controls.implies_capability: Pinning a node's position, which the deterministic 2D layout cannot honor.
inert_controls.requirement: MGR-012 (actions must affect the shipped representation).

inert_controls.site: MemoryGraphFallback.tsx row actions Pin/Unpin -> togglePin(row.id) + 'pinned' Badge
inert_controls.wiring: References undefined local `isPinned`/`togglePin` (TS2304 compile error). Even if wired to graphData.togglePin, the table has no position to pin. Inert AND broken. NOTE its own test 'does not expose inert pin controls' asserts these should be ABSENT.

A '⌘K' keyboard-shortcut hint is rendered next to the filter input, but no ⌘K handler focuses this input or opens a palette. Cosmetic affordance implying a shortcut that isn't wired. NOTE the KnowledgeGraphLens test asserts this kbd should be absent.

visual_claims.backing: HONEST — explicitly labeled generated navigation and excluded from authority relationships (MGR-001.4 aligned). The COUNT 'N memories' is the count of client-categorized visible nodes.
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-001.4 — compliant labeling; the residual issue is the fabricated categorization itself (S-keyword-categorization), not the label.

visual_claims.site: MemoryUniverse legend: 'Memory', 'Generated navigation facet', 'Stored relationship' (only when a stored edge exists), 'Inferred candidate' (only when a predicted edge exists)
visual_claims.backing: PARTIAL-HONEST — legend entries are conditionally shown for encodings present in the scene (MGR-026.4 aligned). But it lacks Truth_State encodings (Current/Stale/Contradicted/etc.) required by MGR-026.3.

visual_claims.site: MemoryUniverse relationship layer <title>'Stored relationship' | 'Inferred candidate': relType — a to b</title>; data-authority-class stored|inferred
visual_claims.claim: Each edge is either a stored relationship or an inferred candidate.
visual_claims.backing: PARTIAL — 'stored' vs 'inferred(predicted)' is backed by graphData's predicted flag; relType falls back to 'type unavailable'. No Provenance/Graph_Revision/Valid_Time attached (MGR-002.3).

visual_claims.site: MemoryUniverse details panel 'Relative score {score.toFixed(2)}' for predicted links
visual_claims.backing: HONEST wording — labeled 'Relative score' (not probability/percentage) per MGR-001.3. BUT missing the required algorithm/profile version alongside the score. (The dormant GraphCanvas3D uses the weaker wording 'score {n}'.)
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-001.3 — labeling compliant; version metadata missing. Underlying value is Adamic-Adar (read-paths R-graph-predict-links) with no interpretation label from the backend (MGR-011.4).

visual_claims.claim: The node belongs to component N.
visual_claims.backing: MISLABELED-AT-SOURCE — the LEAF label uses the correct MGR-011.1 word 'component', but the value comes from `memory_graph_communities` (backend/graphModel still call connected-components 'community'; node.community; buildCommunityIndex; COMMUNITY_COLOR_TOKENS; communityColorToken). Vocabulary corrected only at the table cell, not end-to-end.
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-011.1 — partial; end-to-end `component` rename required (cross-ref read-paths analytics_vocabulary_issues).

visual_claims.backing: PARTIAL — the number is backend degree_centrality, but the UI presents it as bare 'Centrality' with NO named algorithm ('degree') and NO evaluated scope.
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-011.3 (centrality must carry named algorithm + evaluated scope).

visual_claims.site: MemoryGraphFallback focus-relationship rows Status column: 'Confirmed' (check icon) for non-predicted edges vs 'Predicted' Badge
visual_claims.backing: PARTIAL — 'Confirmed' is inferred purely from edge.predicted===false; there is no Truth_State/Provenance/verification backing behind the word 'Confirmed'. Asserts certainty beyond the data.

visual_claims.site: MemoryUniverse core text 'CURRENT FOCUS' / 'Visible memory view' / 'N memories shown'; status header 'Memory Graph — N memories shown'
visual_claims.claim: N memories are shown in the current view.
visual_claims.backing: HONEST — reports the count of currently visible (client-categorized) nodes, i.e. the shown set. Does NOT claim a corpus total. (But cross-ref read-paths: the underlying centrality payload M is a backend-pre-limited number, so any 'N of M' totals derived elsewhere are not the true corpus total.)
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-015.2 / MGR-006.3 honest totals — the universe view avoids the 'N of M' trap by only saying 'N shown'; the fallback table's cap label ('Showing N of M') inherits the pre-limited-M concern from read-paths R-ui-graph-read-layer.

visual_claims.site: graphModel.communityColorToken / COMMUNITY_COLOR_TOKENS mapping node.community -> color token; memoryUniverseModel tone-based hub colors
visual_claims.backing: MISLABELED — color encodes 'community' which is actually connected-components (MGR-011.1) in the table path, and in the universe view color encodes the FABRICATED keyword facet (S-keyword-categorization). Color asserts a grouping that is either mislabeled or invented.
visual_claims.requirement: MGR-011.1 / MGR-026.6 (must not reveal/assert grouping via color without backing).

This confirms design.md §1's 'active MemoryUniverse SVG + semantic table' baseline and its planned migration to an authoritative Canvas2D Memory Control Center (MGR-015/§10.1).

ACTIVE renderer is BROKEN at this commit: `npx tsc --noEmit` fails — MemoryUniverse.tsx references undefined `timeline`/`setTimeline` and MemoryGraphFallback.tsx references undefined `isPinned`/`togglePin`. Both surfaces also CONTRADICT their own vitest/Playwright specs (which describe a cleaner aria-pressed 'Graph display emphasis' toolbar, an 'Open table view' button, a 3-button camera group, and NO Timeline/pin/⌘K). GraphCanvas3D is genuinely DORMANT for the memory graph (no live import mounts it; verified by grep + its own header comment + renderMode.ts note), consistent with the 0.3 invariant that dormant code/comments/tests are not capability proof. NUANCE: its 3D SUPPORT modules (GraphScene/lensController/layout.worker) are NOT globally dead — they are imported and constructed by the SEPARATE live ConstellationCanvas3D in the capabilities space, so 'graph-only' three/ngraph dependencies are reachable there. Any F6 ship-or-delete of memory 3D must coordinate with the constellation lens.

SYNTHETIC TOPOLOGY is pervasive in the universe view: memoryUniverseModel fabricates 9 hardcoded categories, assigns entities by naive keyword substring match (categoryForNode), and computes node positions by hashing ids (placeMemory). A synthetic 'CURRENT FOCUS' core node is always drawn, and graphData.expand injects relationship endpoints as nodes with fabricated labels (id.slice(0,8)) and a made-up centrality=1. Only the facet labeling is honestly marked 'generated navigation' (MGR-001.4); the categorization/layout themselves are invented (MGR-001.1/MGR-015.2).

INERT / MISLEADING CONTROLS: the 'Timeline' button (undefined signal, no timeline view — broken+inert), the lens emphasis toolbar (only toggles a CSS data-lens attribute; does not switch the rendered scene), 'Auto arrange' (actually just resets camera/selection), Pin controls in both the inspector and the table (mutate a `pinned` set that only the DORMANT 3D reads; the fallback's are also undefined/broken), and a ⌘K kbd hint with no wired shortcut. Several are exactly the affordances the tests say should be removed.

VISUAL VOCABULARY/AUTHORITY GAPS: the table's 'Component' badge uses the MGR-011.1-correct word only at the leaf while the value + command remain 'community' (memory_graph_communities = connected components); 'Centrality' is shown with no named algorithm/scope (MGR-011.3); 'Confirmed' relationship status asserts certainty with no Truth_State/Provenance (MGR-001.1); community color encodes a mislabeled/fabricated grouping (MGR-011.1/MGR-026.6). Predicted-link 'Relative score' wording is MGR-001.3-compliant but lacks algorithm/version.

COMMAND CONTRACT: the UI graph surfaces invoke 5 read commands (memory_graph_centrality/communities/relationships/predict_links, memory_explain) and 8 write commands (memory_graph_create_relationship + inspector verify/correct/record_feedback/forget/restore/hard_delete/update), each mapped here to a 0.3.1 write path or 0.3.2 read path. Per core.md the command NAMES are a frozen contract, so the MGR-011.1 community->component rename cannot casually rename `memory_graph_communities` without a coordinated migration.
